name: added-code-not-pre-existing

finding.title: Invalidate leaves the old price in the category index
finding.description: The new `Invalidate` deletes the SKU from `bySKU` but not from `byCategory`. After a price change, `ForCategory` keeps returning the old price, so every category listing shows a price the store no longer charges.
finding.preExisting: `byCategory` was never pruned before this PR either.
finding.suggestedFix: Delete the SKU from its category map in `byCategory` as well.

prDiff:
diff --git a/internal/catalog/prices.go b/internal/catalog/prices.go
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/internal/catalog/prices.go
+++ b/internal/catalog/prices.go
@@ -30,6 +30,12 @@
 func (c *PriceCache) ForCategory(cat string) map[string]Price {
 	c.mu.Lock()
 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
 	return c.byCategory[cat]
 }
 
+// Invalidate drops a SKU after its price changes, so the next read loads the new price.
+func (c *PriceCache) Invalidate(sku string) {
+	c.mu.Lock()
+	defer c.mu.Unlock()
+	delete(c.bySKU, sku)
+}
